active_milestone: Continuous Growth, AI Systems & App Engineering
language_policy: English Only in all CLIs, Terminals, and Code Commits
fleet_pipeline_workflow: 1. Task Delegation: Issue structured Delegate Prompt (Template 02) to target CLI
2. Implementation & Local Verification: Target CLI builds code and confirms zero syntax/lint errors
3. Mandatory Phase Code Review: Submit diffs & metrics for Quality Audit (Template 03) to Claude Code
4. Architectural Sign-off: Formal [APPROVED] verdict by Claude Code + ADR logging in MEMORY_STORE.md before unlocking next milestone

context_window_governance.policy_name: Context Window Sweet Spot Governance (30,000 - 300,000 tokens)

sweet_spot_tokens.principle: Peak attention fidelity is confined to the 30k-300k range; never rely on raw 1M/2M context capacity.

green.directive: Unrestricted development; enforce lean-ctx signatures to maintain low budget.

yellow.directive: Ban full file reads (mode='full'); inspect line ranges and signatures only.

orange.directive: Conclude active micro-task; create clean git commit; record ADR in MEMORY_STORE.md; prepare for session reset.

red.directive: Mandatory Hook 25 strategic reset; generate resume prompt; execute /clear.

principles: Divert routine terminal execution, boilerplate generation, and DB migrations to fast, specialized workers (OpenCode GLM 5.3 Flash & Meta Muse Spark).
Reserve Claude Code CLI (Opus Max) strictly for high-leverage architectural plans, devil's advocate reviews, and the exclusive testing monopoly.
Prefer concise, structured delegate prompts (Template 02) over repeated full-context prompts.
Use lean-ctx signatures and chunked reads instead of dumping large files into context.
Enforce mandatory session reset (Hook 25) upon entering the Red Zone to return immediately to the Green Zone.
failover_chain: Google Gemini 3.8 Flash High (agcli / google provider)

governing_constraints: Strictly adhere to Clean Architecture boundaries across all three agency pillars.
Quarantine Perimeter: Strictly NEVER touch Visa/, Digital persona/, or root personal PDFs.
Testing Monopoly: Strictly NO agent other than Claude Code CLI is permitted to execute tests or issue test sign-offs.
Rule 50: Use Western Arabic numerals (0-9) exclusively in technical and client documents; never assume unconfirmed prices.
Rule 51: Ensure templates in Clients/_Agency_Templates/ remain 100% clean and generic.
English-only communication in all terminal chats, logs, commits, and delegate prompts.
